trial_title: Depocyte in the Treatment of CNS Relapse in Patients With Lymphoblastic Leucemia or Very Aggressive Lymphoma
brief_summary: The first purpose is to confirm or not the efficacy of only one administration of DepoCyte®.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia or very aggressive Non-Hodgkin-Lymphoma (Burkitt/Burkitt-like) and CNS relapse.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has Burkitt's lymphoma, which is classified as a very aggressive Non-Hodgkin-Lymphoma, and there is evidence of CNS involvement.

eligibility_table.criterion: CNS involvement must be demonstrated by:
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's history of viral encephalitis/meningitis and the presence of a mass in the right atrium suggest CNS involvement, although specific CSF cytology results are not provided.

eligibility_table.criterion: A positive ventricular or lumbar CSF cytology defined as CSF cell counts > 5/µl (19/3 cells), obtained within 10 days prior to inclusion OR
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on CSF cell counts or cytology results to confirm the criterion of > 5/µl.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's CSF cell count greater than 5/µl as measured within 10 days prior to inclusion?

eligibility_table.criterion: Characteristic signs and symptoms of neoplastic meningitis PLUS an MRI or CT scan indicating the presence of meningeal involvement. Patients with combined relapse in CNS and other locations may be included in case that systemic therapy with CNS active drugs (HDMTX;HDAC, Thiotepa) can be postponed for at least 2 weeks.
eligibility_table.justification: While there are signs of CNS involvement, the specific MRI or CT scan results indicating meningeal involvement are not provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient exhibit characteristic signs and symptoms of neoplastic meningitis, and does an MRI or CT scan confirm the presence of meningeal involvement?

eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a Karnofsky performance status score of ≥60%?

eligibility_table.criterion: Recovery from grade III/IV toxicities attributable to prior treatment with the exception of hematotoxicity.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has undergone multiple prior treatments and there is no indication of ongoing grade III/IV toxicities.

eligibility_table.criterion: No severe heart, lung, liver or kidney dysfunction.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of cardiac issues (primary cardiac lymphoma) which may indicate severe heart dysfunction.

eligibility_table.criterion: The patient or guardian must be competent to provide informed consent and must provide written informed consent prior to the initiation of study procedures.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is an adult and can provide informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Failure (as defined by no clearance of the CSF) to > 1 dose of prior intrathecal MTX or cytarabine or triple (MTX, ARAC, dexamethasone) therapy
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding the patient's response to prior intrathecal MTX or cytarabine therapy.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient received more than one dose of intrathecal methotrexate or cytarabine or triple therapy (methotrexate, cytarabine, dexamethasone) without achieving clearance of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)?

eligibility_table.criterion: History of previous severe neurotoxicity (grade III-IV) attributed to intrathecal therapy or systemic high-dose therapy with methotrexate or cytarabine (vincristine induced peripheral neuropathy is accepted)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's history does not specify any previous severe neurotoxicity attributed to intrathecal therapy or high-dose therapy.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any episodes of severe neurotoxicity (grade III-IV) attributed to intrathecal therapy or systemic high-dose therapy with methotrexate or cytarabine?
Has the patient experienced a central nervous system relapse within the last 30 days?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding the presence or absence of uncontrolled infections.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient currently have a documented infection, as indicated by a positive culture or elevated inflammatory markers (e.g., CRP, WBC count) within the last 30 days?

eligibility_table.criterion: The patient must not be pregnant or breast feeding. If the patient is a female of child-bearing potential she must have a negative (urine or serum) pregnancy test and be using effective methods to prevent pregnancy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's pregnancy status is not explicitly stated, and while she is of child-bearing potential, there is no information on whether she has a negative pregnancy test or is using effective contraception.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient had a negative urine or serum pregnancy test within the last 7 days?
